text_block_list.text:
It happened one day during a long break 
after the Arima Kinen had finished.

On the desk across the room, dozens of 
manga borrowed from Kiseki were piled up 
high. And—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Did you finish reading it...?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I just finished...!
Yeah, I just finished...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Congratulations on finishing 'The 
Drift Hunt'!
choice_data_list: ああ、今終わったよ……！
うん、今終わったよ……！

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With this, finally! We can go on that hot 
spring trip!!
choice_data_list: Yeah...!

text_block_list.text:
The grand prize won from the shopping 
district raffle: a "Hot Springs Trip 
Voucher." Apparently, the inn is the 
setting of a manga Kiseki loves.
choice_data_list: ああ……！
うん……！

text_block_list.text:
And since I had the chance, I even 
borrowed some manga from Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you actually read it...! 
Even though it's a massive epic with over 
100 volumes...!
choice_data_list:
That way we can enjoy the trip to the 
fullest.

That way we can enjoy the trip to the 
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Trainer-san...!
choice_data_list: そのほうが旅行を全力で楽しめるからな
そのほうが旅行を全力で楽しめるからね

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
choice_data_list: よし！記憶が鮮明なうちに行こう！

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...! The real thing...!

Kiseki clasps her hands together and looks 
up at the inn. It's just like the scene 
where the sub-heroine, Mutsumi, makes her 
entrance in volume 34 of the manga "Nagare 
no Kari."

I was puzzled by how vividly I could 
remember events from the manga. Was this 
the result of that manga training camp?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
They said your mannerisms are just like 
Mutsumi's...

They said your mannerisms remind me of 
Mutsumi...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: 君のしぐさが睦っぽいなって……
貴方のしぐさが睦っぽいなって……

text_block_list.name: Mutsumi
text_block_list.text: “...Do you believe in destiny?”
choice_data_list: That's Mutsumi's line!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Correct, absolutely correct!! So 
then, how did Nagare reply to that!?
choice_data_list: 睦のセリフだー！

text_block_list.text:
I recall manga panels in my head, trying 
to drag up lines the characters said. If I 
remember right, the protagonist Nagare 
said...
choice_data_list:
"I'll believe it when the world ends 
tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaah, ding-dong ding-dooong!
choice_data_list: 『明日世界が終わったら信じるさ』

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Genius?! Incredible! You're officially a 
'Nagare-maniac'!
choice_data_list: Nagare Mania...!?

text_block_list.text:
Does this mean she acknowledges me as a 
fellow comrade worthy of discussing manga 
with?
choice_data_list: ナガレマニア……！？

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sounds good~~!!
choice_data_list: じゃ、じゃあ俺からもクイズ出していいか？
じゃ、じゃあ私からもクイズ出していい？

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Once the quiz is over, let's go take 
photos matching the manga panels!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today is Manga Mania Day for the whole 
day!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Look here!! This is the window 
shown when Nagare and Master were 
talking!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Over here's got an autograph from 
the author!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Trainer! Why don't we buy that 
wooden sword over there!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*... This is baaad...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Today feels just like a dream...!
choice_data_list: It's not a dream!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right! ...Ahahaha!
choice_data_list: 夢じゃないよー！

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...And I don't wanna leave it as just a 
dream either.
choice_data_list:
Because it's real, it'll make for a great 
memory.

Because it's real, it'll make for a great 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It is just as you say.
choice_data_list: 現実だからいい思い出になるんだもんな
現実だからいい思い出になるんだもんね

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll go get some hot water. What about 
you, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I'll relax a little longer before I head 
out.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. ...Well then, I'll be going 
ahead.
choice_data_list: もう少しゆっくりしてから行くよ

text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... Such a nice scent... And the 
stars are so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you still in your room, Trainer? You 
were looking pretty exhausted, after all."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Going out of your way to read all the 
manga volumes, and playing along with my 
silly antics..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...What a kind person.

“...Bright light filters through the 
cracks of my eyelids. It seems I had 
fallen asleep.”
choice_data_list: Huh, where's Kiseki...

text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if she's relaxing in her room 
too."
choice_data_list: あれ、キセキは……

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Oh, Kiseki. There you are.
Huh, Kiseki. So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to see the night scenery as 
well.
choice_data_list: あれ、キセキ。ここにいたのか
あれ、キセキ。ここにいたんだ

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, did you just wake up?
choice_data_list: Well, something like that...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's no wonder you're tired. You've 
been dragged around by me since morning, 
after all.
choice_data_list: まあそんなところで……

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't push yourself too 
hard.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Because, you're the kind of Trainer 
who'd go all out going along with my 
hobbies, aren't you?"
choice_data_list: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you keep being nice like that all the 
time, you're going to burn out eventually.
choice_data_list: You don't need to be that considerate...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so-?
choice_data_list: そんなに気を使われなくても

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh.
choice_data_list: だって、キセキだから付き合っているんだよ

text_block_list.text:
I look back on the days I've spent with 
Kiseki so far. Every day with her has been 
truly wonderful.
choice_data_list: 君と過ごせば絶対に面白くなるって思って
貴方と過ごせば絶対に面白くなるって思って

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "H-Hey! Trainer?!"
choice_data_list: だからこれからも君と――
だからこれからも貴方と――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Putting it that way is a bit... 
embarrassing.
choice_data_list:
Why? I always praise you for being funny, 
don't I?

Why? I always praise you for being funny, 
don't I?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's true, but... Man...
choice_data_list: なんで？いつも面白いって褒めてるだろ
なんで？いつも面白いって褒めてるでしょ

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... What is this feeling? Maybe I'm 
just a little too happy...

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Kiseki...
